modules.name: Sprout
modules.description: A rhythm that grows by L-system rules (Fibonacci, Thue-Morse, Cantor...): each generation packs more hits into the bar, or read as an endless stream; A/B/C trigger outs

modules.name: Graft
modules.description: Four-lane drum groove rewritten by chance rules each generation: ratchet, drop, sprout and home, so it mutates but stays related

modules.name: Bloom
modules.description: Chord progressions grown by L-system rules on scale degrees, in six modes, voice-led; poly chord, bass, gate and change outs
